trigger: A shell here-document failed with No space left on device while full QA was running. The full-test process later exited 1; its log ends without a test summary, so the attempt is inconclusive.
scope: Only files under the assigned worktree tmp directory. Current primitive/ribbon/flower/finalist/projective experiments were excluded. No source-image or experiment file was deleted.
method: Independent APFS copy-on-write clones replace byte-identical generated artifacts atomically after checksum verification. Self-checks confirmed writes to either copy remain independent. Every replaced file retained bytes, mode and modification time.
qualification: Available-space changes also include concurrent system activity. A ditto compression test did not reduce allocated blocks and was discarded without altering its original file.

runs.method: APFS independent copy-on-write clones of byte-identical generated artifacts; all file paths, bytes, modes and modification times preserved. No hard links or source-image deletion.
runs.limitation: Available-space difference also includes unrelated concurrent system activity.
